summary: Confirmed the MANDATORY_TESTING_VALIDATION circularity mechanism at every cited file:line, found no prior fix attempt, and identified a load-bearing safety distinction the VALIDATION agent's report did not surface: two different deliverable-completion implementations exist with very different trust profiles.
detailed_analysis: Mechanism confirmed: mandatory-testing-validation.js (required:true) reads a stored sub_agent_execution_results TESTING row; phase4-evidence.js:152-157 requires user_stories.status IN (completed,validated); the only promoter (auto-validate-user-stories-on-exec-complete.js:222-227) requires every sd_scope_deliverables row completed first; deliverables only complete via reconcileDeliverables (gates/deliverables-completeness.js, evidence-gated) or autoCompleteDeliverablesForSD (exec-to-plan/index.js:412, called only inside executeSpecific() which runs AFTER gates pass). sub-agent-orchestration.js:102-135 reuses a fresh <24h PASS/CONDITIONAL_PASS TESTING row instead of re-running TESTING inside the handoff, so the pre-handoff standalone TESTING run is the ONLY evaluation that can ever produce the row MANDATORY_TESTING_VALIDATION reads -- it structurally cannot observe healed state. No prior commit/SD targets this defect (fresh branch, no grep hits for heal-then-measure). Directly relevant precedent: SD-LEO-FIX-EXEC-PLAN-ACCEPTED-001 (PR #8059) hardened the verdict-acceptance gate specifically because a softened/bypassed TESTING verdict once let a broken SD read as completed -- do not touch verdict acceptance. lib/sub-agents/testing/index.js already has resolveStoryGateContext() (added by QF-20260903-748, lines 405-426) classifying PRE_IMPLEMENTATION (non-blocking) vs POST_IMPLEMENTATION (blocking) handoff types -- exactly the guard a heal-then-measure step needs, already built and tested; reuse it, don't reinvent it. CRITICAL SAFETY FINDING not in the VALIDATION report: there are two deliverable-completion code paths with very different trust profiles. gates/deliverables-completeness.js reconcileDeliverables() is genuinely evidence-gated (5 specific checks, leaves unmatched deliverables untouched). scripts/modules/handoff/auto-complete-deliverables.js autoCompleteDeliverables() (the one autoCompleteDeliverablesForSD actually calls) has an unconditional zero-evidence fallback tier AUTO_COMPLETE_HANDOFF_CONTEXT (confidence 50, fires when 'no verification sources matched', lines 364-379) that marks deliverables completed with NO real evidence, by design. A naive fix wiring TESTING's heal step to autoCompleteDeliverablesForSD would let a standalone TESTING run fabricate deliverable completion via that rubber-stamp tier and then measure against its own fabrication -- reproducing the self-authored-evidence problem CLAUDE.md's provenance rule forbids, one layer down. Recommended fix: in lib/sub-agents/testing/index.js, hoist resolveStoryGateContext(options) before verifyUserStories() (currently line 212), and when .blocking===true, call ONLY reconcileDeliverables() (export it from deliverables-completeness.js) then autoValidateUserStories() (safe no-op if still incomplete) before measuring -- explicitly never call autoCompleteDeliverablesForSD/autoCompleteDeliverables from this path. Never touch mandatory-testing-validation.js's verdict-acceptance list or subagent-evidence-gate.js's rejecting-verdict-always-fails rule.

findings.duplicate_check: PASS -- no duplicate. SD-LEO-FIX-EXEC-PLAN-ACCEPTED-001 (completed) is the complement, not an overlap: it made a bypass visible; this SD removes the need for it.
findings.unsafe_direction_identified: Wiring the heal step to autoCompleteDeliverablesForSD/autoCompleteDeliverables would exercise its zero-evidence AUTO_COMPLETE_HANDOFF_CONTEXT fallback tier (confidence 50), fabricating deliverable completion -- must use reconcileDeliverables() only, which has no such fallback.
findings.reusable_infrastructure: resolveStoryGateContext() in lib/sub-agents/testing/index.js (QF-20260903-748) already classifies PRE_IMPLEMENTATION vs POST_IMPLEMENTATION handoff types -- the exact guard the heal step needs.
